title: Supply Chain Attack on finch-rst
technical_mechanism: -- # `finch-rst` was removed from crates.io for malicious code This attempts to typosquat the existing crate [`finch`](https://crates.io/crates/finch) to steal credentials from local files. The malicious crate had 1 version published on 2025-12-08 and had been downloaded 21 times. There were no crates
